questions.q: What request field turns on streaming for the Messages API?
questions.explain: Adding "stream": true to the same request body switches the response to Server-Sent Events.

questions.q: What transport does Anthropic's streaming Messages API use?
options: Server-Sent Events (SSE) over a kept-open HTTP connection
A new TCP connection per word
questions.explain: Streaming uses SSE: plain HTTP kept open, with event:/data: pairs pushed down the same connection. (Not WebSockets.)

questions.q: Which event is always the FIRST one sent in a Messages API stream?
questions.explain: message_start opens every stream, with an empty content array on the Message object it carries.

questions.q: Where does the final stop_reason (e.g. "end_turn") appear in a streamed response?
options: It never appears in streaming mode
questions.explain: message_delta carries top-level changes to the final Message object, including stop_reason and cumulative usage.

questions.q: What should a well-behaved streaming client do with a ping event it doesn't specifically handle?
options: Treat it as an error and abort the stream
Append its data to the accumulated message text
Ignore it — ping events just keep the connection alive
questions.explain: ping events can appear at any point in the stream; clients should ignore event types they don't recognize rather than failing.
